label: Demo copy
source: Team draft from the design mockup (ARGUS_v13). Not from a published protocol.
notifyNow: Crew medical officer, in person or on the loop. Then the flight surgeon: message queued to ground.
meanwhile: Stop strenuous work and rest. Re-measure in 10 minutes. Follow the card's “What you can do”. Chest pain, collapse or confusion: open emergency steps.
delayLongText: Act now. Do not wait for Earth.
delayShortText: ground is effectively live, but keep acting while you talk.
